rule.description: 文档中的注释和说明文字应使用语法正确的英文，避免中式英语或语法错误影响文档专业性和可读性。
checkpoints: 检查文档注释中是否存在主谓一致、时态、单复数等语法错误
确认 "use follow images" 等常见错误表述已修正为 "uses the following image"
检查冠词、介词使用是否正确

antipattern.code:
## Prerequisites

- A2 series GPU server (e.g., 910B4*8)
- Docker installed and configured

## Docker Image Configuration

```bash
    # deepseek-v4-flash use follow images
    export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:{{ vllm_ascend_version }}

    # deepseek-v4-flash-dspark uses the following image
    export IMAGE=swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/desaysv/vllm-ascend-dspark:910b4
```
# ↑ "use follow images" 语法错误，应为 "uses the following image"

pattern.code:
## Prerequisites

- A2 series GPU server (e.g., 910B4*8)
- Docker installed and configured

## Docker Image Configuration

```bash
    # deepseek-v4-flash uses the following image
    export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:{{ vllm_ascend_version }}

    # deepseek-v4-flash-dspark uses the following image
    export IMAGE=swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/desaysv/vllm-ascend-dspark:910b4
```
# ↑ 已修正为语法正确的 "uses the following image"
